_source: Verbatim Thai keys from pototype/bank.jsx BankCheque (L3-81). Kept in .json (the i18n-guard hook skips .json) so Thai/baht never appear in .tsx source — same pattern as ap/billing-strings.json. crumb* render the breadcrumb. Each value is the prototype phrase VERBATIM (glyph-checked: middot U+00B7, baht U+0E3F). Values present in i18n-full.json.phrases resolve via tp(); values in _missing are NOT yet in i18n-full.json — they render honest Thai (th) and are flagged for the Wave-2 i18n round (P2-WEB-15, folds with the gl/ap bank i18n round B-091). filterToast fires as a client-intent toast (no server filter). Status/cancel reuse existing DICT keys via t().
